candidates.description: This vector represents Hebrew letters and characters commonly found in Hebrew text encoding.
This feature vector activates on terms related to Jewish culture, religion, history, and people, with occasional semantic spillover to other Abrahamic religions.
This vector represents concepts related to cultural heritage, societal norms, and historical practices versus contemporary methods.
This vector represents the concept of change, variation, and difference.
This vector represents the concept of religion, faith, and spirituality along with their morphological variants and semantic associations.
This vector represents the concept of translation, interpretation, and the conveyance of meaning between different forms or languages.
This feature vector activates concepts related to Christianity, including its religious figures, texts, institutions, and adherents.
This vector represents quantifiers and qualifiers indicating frequency, amount, or degree.
This vector represents instances, events, or specific circumstances related to situations and occurrences.
These tokens function as conjunctive adverbs and transitional transition markers used to connect clauses and indicate logical relationships between sentences.
